# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project

**Realesty** — French real-estate mobile app (sellers, buyers, partner agencies). Flutter app (Dart package name `mobileapp`) generated by Very Good CLI. State management with `bloc`/`flutter_bloc`. Targets Flutter `^3.47.0` / Dart `^3.13.0` (CI pins `3.47.x`).

## V1 scope & decisions

- Goal: a first version installed on the owner's iPhone. Backend: **Supabase** (EU region).
- Bundle ID / applicationId: `fr.realesty.mobile` (flavors add `.dev` / `.stg`); display names `Realesty`, `[DEV] Realesty`, `[STG] Realesty`.
- iOS signing uses a **free Apple account**: installed builds expire after 7 days, and Sign in with Apple, push notifications and TestFlight are unavailable. Stick to the `development` flavor on device (each flavor is a separate app ID, and free accounts have tight app-ID limits).
- V1 screens: common zone (Splash, Connexion, Rôle) + seller tunnel V1–V8 (owners → documents, then "dossier envoyé"), persisted in Supabase.
- Auth v1: **email magic link** (Supabase `signInWithOtp` + `emailRedirectTo`, PKCE). Apple and Google buttons from the design are hidden until later.
- Work is documented in `docs/` (French): implementation plans in `docs/plans/AAAA-MM-JJ-sujet.md` (written before coding, with an execution log updated as it progresses), epics/user stories in `docs/epics/`, and the owner's product decisions + unplanned backlog in `docs/decisions.md`. Update them in the same change as the code. `README.md` is in English (the CI spell check covers it; `docs/**` and `CLAUDE.md` are excluded).
- Roadmap: screen-first seller tunnel (done) → non-certified price estimate (EPIC-05: DVF sales + price/m² trend, no listings in v1, shown on V8 and V8b) and voice + AI agent (EPIC-06) → seller Dashboard (V9+).
- **AI goes through OpenRouter only**, called from Supabase Edge Functions (models configurable by secrets; voice agent defaults = the cheapest benchmarked models for the test phase, agent `google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite` — owner decision 2026-10-02, to reassess after tests); the key is the Supabase secret `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and must never appear in the app, the repo or `config/`. AI may phrase explanations or extract answers, never invent figures.
- Maps: Mapbox is the chosen provider (pending the public token); V2 currently uses a custom Web-Mercator widget (`steps/location/widgets/parcel_map.dart`).

## Design source of truth

The UI is designed in Claude Design, canvas **"Realesty · App mobile"**: https://claude.ai/artifact/7iUZPTfM8Kf6xrEY4nnS5v (read it with the Artifact tool — `read_file` on `project/canvas.json` for the index, then `project/<Screen>.dc.html` for a screen; never web-fetch it). Screens are 390px-wide phone artboards, UI copy is in French. Canvas rows:

- **Design system**: `DS-Fondations.dc.html` (colors, type, spacing) and `DS-Composants.dc.html` (components) — derive the Flutter theme/widgets from these.
- **Zone commune & routage** (00–02, C1–C3): splash, discover, login, role selector, coffre-fort, account, partners.
- **Tunnel vendeur** (V1–V8b): conversational property audit (owners, cadastre, audits, surfaces, documents, market synthesis).
- **Vendeur · Dashboard, offres & gestion** (V9–V19): dashboard, valuation report, offers (1 % Essentiel / Premium, 3 % Expert), visits, negotiation, sale tracking.
- **Tunnel acquéreur** (A1–A16): lifestyle search, financial check-up, results, property sheets, visit booking, purchase tracking.
- **Tunnel agent partenaire** (P1–P11): agency onboarding, cockpit, mandate delegation.

Artboard titles carry these screen codes (e.g. "V9 · Dashboard propriétaire"); use them to name features/routes.

## Commands

```sh
# Run a flavor (development | staging | production) — each has its own entrypoint
flutter run --flavor development --target lib/main_development.dart --dart-define-from-file=config/development.json

# All tests with coverage (what CI runs; CI also enforces coverage)
very_good test --coverage --test-randomize-ordering-seed random

# Single test file / single test by name
flutter test test/login/cubit/login_cubit_test.dart
flutter test test/app/router/app_redirect_test.dart --plain-name "<test name>"

# Local packages have their own tests
(cd packages/auth_repository && dart test)

# Install on the owner's iPhone (free Personal Team 73QD6VU5LA, set as DEVELOPMENT_TEAM in ios/Runner.xcodeproj).
# Use --release: iOS debug builds can't be opened from the home screen without a debugger attached.
flutter build ios --flavor development --target lib/main_development.dart --dart-define-from-file=config/development.json --release
# Same, with the dev test sign-in (gitignored config/development.local.json, see Supabase > Auth):
flutter build ios --flavor development --target lib/main_development.dart --dart-define-from-file=config/development.json --dart-define-from-file=config/development.local.json --release
xcrun devicectl list devices   # find the device UDID
xcrun devicectl device install app --device <UDID> build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app
# If signing reports "no devices"/"no profiles", create the profile once with:
#   (cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace Runner.xcworkspace -scheme development -configuration Debug-development \
#     -destination 'id=<UDID>' -allowProvisioningUpdates -allowProvisioningDeviceRegistration build)

# Regenerate the iOS app icon after changing assets/app_icon/icon.png
dart run flutter_launcher_icons

# Static analysis + formatting
flutter analyze
dart format .

# Bloc lint (enforced in CI via run_bloc_lint)
dart run bloc_tools:bloc lint .

# Regenerate localizations after editing ARB files
flutter gen-l10n --arb-dir="lib/l10n/arb"
```

## Architecture

- **Entrypoints**: `lib/main_{development,staging,production}.dart` call `bootstrap(App.new)`. `lib/bootstrap.dart` installs error logging and the `AppBlocObserver`, registers font licenses, calls `Supabase.initialize`, builds the repositories (`AuthRepository`, `ProfileRepository`, `PropertyRepository`, `GeoRepository`, `OnboardingRepository`, `ValuationRepository`, `NotificationRepository`) and hands them to `App`.
- **Layers**: data access lives in local packages `packages/auth_repository` (magic link, user stream, link failures), `packages/profile_repository` (`profiles` table), `packages/property_repository` (seller dossiers), `packages/sale_repository` (certified valuations, in-app notifications; later the sale) and `packages/geo_repository` (address search via data.geopf.fr/geocodage — api-adresse.data.gouv.fr is shut down — and cadastre parcels via apicarto.ign.fr; no Supabase). Features never touch Supabase directly.
- **App-level state** (`lib/app/view/app.dart`): `AppBloc` (auth status), `ProfileCubit` (profile/role) and `LoginCubit` (kept app-level so it survives 01b↔01c navigation and catches magic-link failures) are provided above `MaterialApp.router`.
- **Routing**: `go_router` in `lib/app/router/`. All navigation rules live in the pure function `appRedirect` (auth status × onboarding seen × profile state → location), refreshed from the AppBloc/ProfileCubit streams. `/design-system` (gallery) exists only in the development flavor. `FlutterDeepLinkingEnabled` is false on iOS, so the auth callback URL goes to supabase_flutter (app_links), not to go_router.
- **Seller tunnel** (`lib/seller_tunnel/`, V1–V8): data in `packages/property_repository` (`properties` + child tables, private Storage bucket `property-documents` under `<user id>/<property id>/`; migrations `supabase/migrations/*_create_seller_tunnel.sql`, RLS owner-only).
  - **Several properties per seller** (EPIC-13, `*_multi_biens.sql`): ≤ 5 per seller (DB trigger, `PropertyLimitFailure`), the app chooses the id of a new property (`generateUuidV4`, retry-safe insert). `SellerTunnelShell` (ShellRoute over `/vendeur`) provides `SellerPropertiesCubit` (properties, lots, parcels of lot members; creates the first property of a new seller) and the `SellerTunnelCubits` registry (one `SellerTunnelCubit` per property, kept for the session). Every screen of a property lives under `/vendeur/biens/<id>/…` and is wrapped by `PropertyRouteScope` (provides that property's cubit, loading/failure, not found → `/vendeur`, redirects, save navigation on the visible screen only). Routes: `AppRoutes.sellerProperty(id)` (home), `sellerPropertyAudit(id, segment)`, `sellerReport(id)`, `sellerMarket(id)`, `sellerNewProperty`, `sellerLot(id)`; old `/vendeur/rapport|marche|audit/<step>` go through `LegacySellerRedirect` (most recently updated property).
  - **Type of property** drives the tunnel through the single pure model `PropertyTypeProfile.of(type)` (`lib/seller_tunnel/models/`): steps (garage: V1 → V4b → V7), header "k/n", V3 precision, V4b `TechnicalField`s, V6 neighbourhood, V7 documents, score answers, voice, estimate, and `clearedFrom` (answers hidden by a type change are kept in drafts, cleared when sent). Voice/estimate parity with the Edge Functions: `supabase/functions/tests/fixtures/property_type_profiles.json`. Labels/icons: `property_type_labels.dart`.
  - `SellerTunnelStep` lists the screens (number 1–7 stored in `current_step`, 8 = submitted; `segment`, `routeFor(propertyId)`, `fromSegment`); next/previous come from the profile (`nextAfter`, `previousBefore`).
  - **Lock**: RLS (`*_lock_submitted_dossiers.sql`, `*_lock_document_files.sql` for Storage) allows writes only while `status` is draft/submitted. In the app a dossier is locked as soon as it is sent (`SellerTunnelState.isLocked`: status ≠ draft): `resumeStep` is V8 and `PropertyRouteScope` redirects every editable step to V8 (`SellerTunnelState.redirectFor`); there is no "edit after sending" flow.
  - **Sale lots** (`property_lots`, `properties.lot_id`): same owner only, frozen once a member is in_review/certified (triggers + RLS, `LotFrozenFailure`). "Mes biens" (`lib/seller_space/my_properties/`), "Ajouter un bien" (`new_property/`: type, lot, owners + identity copied server-side), fiche du lot (`lot/`, estimate = sum of the members' estimates in the app, `LotEstimate`, an outbuilding on the main dwelling's parcel is not added).
  - **One page file per step**: `lib/seller_tunnel/steps/<step>/<step>_page.dart` (+ its test), with a step-local cubit (Page/View split) and its models/widgets next to it. The full walk V1 → V8 is tested in `test/app/view/app_test.dart`.
  - Step pattern: "Continuer" is always enabled — an invalid tap shows every error and scrolls to the first one; all inputs are disabled while the step or the tunnel saves; network writes time out after 15 s (`SellerTunnelCubit.defaultTimeout`).
  - Child rows: either client-generated UUIDs (upserts, retry-safe) or record each returned id right after each successful write (reload the rows before retrying when an insert answer may have been lost). Provenance is only written via `Property.mergeProvenance`.
  - Cubit API: `saveAndContinue(step, {PropertyColumns.x: value})` saves and advances `current_step` (the scope navigates to `nextStep` or shows a save-error snackbar); `save(patch)`; child rows via `context.read<PropertyRepository>()` then `updateChildren(...)`. Navigation (reads the open property): `context.goBackFrom(step)`, `goToTunnelStep`, `leaveTunnel`, `propertyHomeLocation(id)` (`/vendeur` for the only property).
  - Widgets (`lib/seller_tunnel/widgets/`): `TunnelScaffold`, `TunnelHeader`, `AgentActionBar(hint:, label:, onPressed:, isLoading:, trailingIcon:, onMicPressed:)` (mic shown only with `onMicPressed` and voice available), `AgentIntro`, `SelectableCard(Grid)`, `SectionLabel`, `SectionTitle`. Tests: `tester.pumpTunnelPage(page, sellerTunnelCubit: mockSellerTunnelCubit(state))`.
  - Data notes: heating is the multi-value `heating_systems` (`HeatingSystem`); `heating_energy` is legacy and no longer written. V5c writes `living_area_m2` (habitable rooms) and `annex_area_m2` (`rooms.is_annex`; provenance `document` when every room was read on a plan). V7 scans go through `cunning_document_scanner` (VisionKit; image_picker camera fallback), multi-page captures are combined into one PDF in a background isolate (`data/scan_pdf_builder.dart`, `pdf` + `image`, ≤ 20 MB); imported images lose their metadata before upload (`PhotoProcessor.stripMetadata` → `cleanDocumentImage`: lossless `photos/data/image_metadata.dart` for JPEG / PNG / HEIF, else re-encoded, else the file is refused; PDFs untouched); only the title deed and an ID document are required to submit, plus a photo of each main room for the types with rooms (EPIC-15).
  - l10n: keys prefixed by step, added to the ARB files with a JSON read-modify-write script (fr template + en + es), then `flutter gen-l10n` immediately.
- **Voice + AI agent** (EPIC-06, extended to every step by EPIC-14): `packages/voice_repository` (`VoiceRecorder` = `record`, AAC 16 kHz m4a, levels; `VoicePlayer` = `audioplayers` from a temp file; `SpeechEndDetector`) and `packages/agent_repository` (`AgentRepository` → Edge Functions `agent-transcribe` / `agent-turn` / `agent-speech`; `AgentStep` location · context · technical · rooms · lifestyle — V1 has no voice since EPIC-16). `lib/seller_tunnel/voice/`: `VoiceServices` (provided by `App`; available only when `VOICE_ENABLED` is true in `config/<flavor>.json` — development only), `VoicePreferences` (consent v4, muted voice, input mode, quota/offline/mic flags), `ensureVoiceConsent` (RGPD screen on first use), `VoiceConversationCubit` (listen → transcribe → turn → apply → speak loop), `VoiceDefaults` (owner choices pending, plan EPIC-14 §14).
  - **Step sheets** (EPIC-14): each step cubit mixes in `VoiceFormMixin` (`VoiceForm`: pure `applyVoiceTurn(state, turn)` on its unsaved draft, `voiceContext` = draft / rooms R1… / estimates E1… / co-owner count; undo of a turn, a pill or a session by replaying from the snapshot before the turn). `showStepVoiceSheet` opens the Night `StepVoiceSheet` (pills with their "Annuler" cross, Oui / Non confirmations, "Annuler ce tour", out-of-step pills; "oui / non / annule / terminé" recognised locally, `LocalVoiceCommand`); nothing is saved before "Continuer"; values said carry `DictatedTag` ("Dicté"). V5c dictation (`?dictee=1` from the V5 card) is silent with a spoken summary (`AgentRepository.roomsSummary`); dictated rooms get `RoomSource.voice` and a `description`. V2's address is a plain dictation (`VoiceDictationCubit`, transcription only). `PropertyTypeProfile.voiceSteps` / `hasVoice(step)` decide the microphone, `voiceAudit` the V4 Night audit (V4b's "Conversation guidée" link). V4 `VoiceAuditPage` (`/vendeur/biens/<id>/audit/technique-vocal`) still saves its turns through `SellerTunnelCubit.save`.
  - **Voice first** (EPIC-16, plan `docs/plans/2026-10-03-voix-prioritaire.md`, owner choices pending → `VoiceDefaults` / `VOICE_DEFAULTS`): V2–V6 open their sheet by themselves in the voice mode (`VoiceFirstLauncher`, scheduled by `StepVoiceFirst.schedule`; not on a validated step without pending answers, nor with quota/offline/mic refused); « Écrire plutôt » sets `VoiceInputMode.text` (per device), the action bar's « Répondre à la voix » sets it back. What is said for another step becomes a **pending answer** (`pending_answers`, written by `agent-turn` via the RPC `agent_record_pending`, never applied by the server): `SellerTunnelCubit` keeps them (`pendingFor(step)`, `visiblePending`, `resolvePending`) and is the sheet's `VoicePendingSink` (update of a validated step = `acceptPendingUpdate`). Each step page provides a `StepTraceCubit` (`StepVoiceFirst.createTrace`: its « Notes complémentaires » `properties.step_notes`, its pending answers pre-filled « À confirmer » — `ToConfirmTag`) and saves with `StepVoiceFirst.save` (adds `field_sources` — origin of each value, `FieldSource` — and `step_notes`) then `saveStepAndContinue(step, patch, resolve: …)`. Pending rooms / estimates / items become rows of the step form, resolved at « Continuer »; V7 shows a non-blocking `PendingAnswersCard`; open ones expire at submission (trigger). Staff: `staff_fill_sheet` / `staff_voice_thread` (`docs/runbooks/fiche-de-remplissage.md`).
  - Server (`supabase/functions/_shared/agent/`): step registry `steps/` (fields, entities, instructions, voiced types per step; parity fixture `tests/fixtures/property_type_profiles.json`), `validate.ts` (whitelist, literal quote, numeric anchors with `french_numbers.ts`, lexical anchors and free-text coverage `anchors.ts`, entities and room designation `rooms.ts`, confirmations only for `interactive` sheets, corrections, out-of-step), `defaults.ts` (owner choices). The functions never write the dossier: the app does (RLS, lock). The journal (`agent_sessions`, `agent_turns`) is read-only for clients: the functions check ownership + draft + step × type with the caller's JWT, then write it with the service role (quotas on server-measured audio; dictated addresses are not kept; phones/e-mails masked (`maskContacts`) before the model; `extracted.evidence` = quote of every retained value; `cross_step` validated with the target step's definitions (`crossStepTargets`, catalog of the other steps in a second cacheable system block); `agent_turns.undone`; cost/quality view `agent_step_stats`, runbook `docs/runbooks/suivi-voix.md`).
- **Room photos + vision AI** (EPIC-15, plan `docs/plans/2026-10-02-photos-du-bien.md`): `room_photos` (one row per photo, `room_id` FK cascade, files in `property-documents` under `<uid>/<property>/photos/<room>/<photo>.jpg`, 12 per room / 150 per property by trigger, `rooms.photos_count` kept by triggers, `analysis` written by the backend only) and `vision_requests` (journal + quotas, service role). `lib/seller_tunnel/photos/` is independent of the tunnel cubit (reusable at V11a): `PhotoServices` (provided by `App`: camera `camera` + level `sensors_plus`, library `image_picker`, `PhotoProcessor` = `image` in an isolate: upright, ≤ 2048 px JPEG, brightness / Laplacian sharpness / tilt checks; `PhotoPreferences` = vision consent v1), `RoomPhotosCubit` (sequential uploads, retry, delete, put first — one RPC `reorder_room_photos`, analyses; the last photo of a main room of a submitted dossier cannot be deleted: trigger, `RoomPhotoRequiredFailure`), `RoomPhotosPage` / `showRoomPhotos` (returns the photo count and the room answers with the accepted suggestions — `RoomPhotoSuggestions`), `PhotoCapturePage`, `PhotoConsentPage` / `ensurePhotoAnalysisConsent`. V5c opens it from each row or the room sheet after `SurfacesCubit.preparePhotos` (the room row must exist); a removed room loses its photos first. V5 « Lire un plan » (`steps/method/plan/`: `PlanReadingCubit`, `PlanReviewPage`) stores the photo as a `plan` document, reads it (`plan-reader`) and writes the kept rooms (`source = plan`). V7 blocks sending while a main room has no photo (`PropertyTypeProfile.requiresRoomPhotos`, `DocumentChecklist.missingPhotoRooms`, photos weigh 15 in the score). Parity of the AI options with V5c: `supabase/functions/tests/fixtures/vision_options.json`.
- **Seller space** (`lib/seller_space/`, EPIC-07): inside the seller `ShellRoute` (navigator `sellerNavigatorKey`), a `StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack` with 4 tabs built by `SellerTabScaffold` (`RealestyTabBar`): Mon bien `/vendeur` (`MyPropertyPage`: with one property its `PropertyHomePage` — `SellerHomePage` while draft, V9 `DashboardPage` once sent, plus an "Ajouter un bien" card; with several, "Mes biens"; `/vendeur/biens/<id>/rapport` = V9b `ReportPage`), Visites `/vendeur/visites` and Coffre-fort `/vendeur/coffre` (`ComingSoonPage`), Compte `/vendeur/compte` (`AccountPage`: sign out, dev design-system link). Tunnel steps V1–V8 stay sub-routes of `/vendeur` with `parentNavigatorKey: sellerNavigatorKey` (full screen above the tabs, Mon bien underneath). `SellerSpaceProviders` gives the tabs `NotificationsCubit` (notifications carry their `propertyId`); `PropertyValuationScope` gives a property's pages its `ValuationCubit` (loaded once certified); pull to refresh uses `SellerTunnelCubit.refresh()`. Links to routes other epics add (V8b `/vendeur/marche`) only show when `isRouteAvailable`.
  - Certification has no app UI: staff run `staff_start_review` / `staff_certify_property` / `staff_attach_valuation_report` in the SQL editor (`docs/runbooks/certifier-un-dossier.md`). `valuations` / `notifications` are read-only for the app (except `notifications.read_at`); PDFs are in the private bucket `valuation-reports` (`<owner id>/<property id>/…`). Notifications are in-app only (no push, no e-mail).
- **Sales** (EPIC-08, plan `docs/plans/2026-10-03-offres-et-mise-en-vente.md`, runbook `docs/runbooks/suivre-une-vente.md`): TEST mandates only, no payment. `SaleRepository` (`packages/sale_repository`) is given to `App` only when `SALES_ENABLED` (`config/development.json`); without it V9/V9b keep « bientôt » (`saleRepositoryOf`, `SalesBuilder`). A sale (`sales`) is about a property **or** a lot (lot « ensemble ou séparément »: the lot or its properties, never both; a lot can be sold once its main property is certified — `SaleEntry`). State changes only through RPCs (`choose_formula`, `sign_test_mandate`, `request_sale_service`, `publish_listing`, `withdraw_sale`…); typed `SaleFailure`. `lib/seller_space/sale/`: `SalesScope` (in `SellerTunnelShell`: `SalesCubit` = active sales for V9 « Ma vente » / lot page / « Mes biens », `SaleCubits` = one `SaleCubit` per sale), routes `saleRoutes` (`/vendeur/ventes/<id>` = activation of its formula V11 / V11b / V11c, `…/annonce` V11a, `…/annonce/photos`, `…/annonce/apercu`), V10 `showOfferChoiceSheet`, `MandateSignatureForm` (drawn signature → `mandate-signatures` → RPC → Edge Function `render-mandate` writes the « SPÉCIMEN » PDF to `sale-documents`), listing photos copied from `room_photos` into `listing-media` (all of them, owner decision) or taken with the EPIC-15 photo screen (`showPhotoCaptureFor` + `PhotoCaptureTarget`), listing text from `listingTextOf` (deterministic), diagnostics preselection `presetDiagnostics`. Cubit actions return `Future<void>` and leave `SaleState.failure`.
- **Non-certified estimate** (EPIC-05): Edge Function `supabase/functions/estimate-property` (Deno; shared code in `_shared/dvf` and `_shared/estimation`, tests in `supabase/functions/tests`, run `deno test --allow-read tests/` from `supabase/functions`, CI `edge_functions.yaml`) computes once per sent dossier from DVF sales (geo-dvf cache in `dvf_sources`/`dvf_sales`, service role only) into `market_snapshots` (owner read-only) and copies the range to `properties.ai_estimate_*`. The app requests it after V7 (`PropertyRepository.requestEstimate`), V8 polls it (`AiEstimateCubit`), V8b `/vendeur/marche` (`lib/seller_tunnel/market/`) shows it. No adjustments in v1; AI (OpenRouter, `OPENROUTER_MODEL_ESTIMATE`) only phrases the explanation, numbers are checked. Garages / outbuildings (EPIC-13) are estimated per unit from DVF sales of a single « Dépendance » (`_shared/estimation/outbuilding.ts`, template explanation, `dvf_sources.format_version` 2 re-cleans older cached files).
- **Design system**: `lib/ui/` (barrel `lib/ui/ui.dart`): tokens (`RealestyColors` ThemeExtension via `context.realestyColors`, spacing/radius/shadows/motion), `RealestyTextStyles`, `realestyTheme()`, `RealestyIcon`, `RealestyLogo`, components (`Realesty*`). Build screens from these, never with raw hex values or ad-hoc styles. Fonts (Sora, Hanken Grotesk, Michroma) are bundled assets; use `frenchNumber` for numbers (fonts lack U+202F).
- **Feature-first layout**: each feature lives in `lib/<feature>/` with `cubit/` (or `bloc/`) and `view/` subfolders and a barrel file `lib/<feature>/<feature>.dart` that exports them. Import features through the barrel (`package:mobileapp/login/login.dart`).
- **Page/View split**: a `XPage` widget creates and provides the cubit via `BlocProvider`; a separate `XView` consumes it. Tests exercise `XView` directly with a `MockCubit` injected via `BlocProvider.value`.
- **Material import**: widgets import `package:material_ui/material_ui.dart` rather than `package:flutter/material.dart` — follow that convention.
- **Dart syntax**: the codebase uses primary-constructor style (`const new({super.key});`, `new() : super(0);`) — match it in new classes.

## Supabase

- Project "Mobileapp", ref `xbteiljpjfmiianlmbwn`, region eu-west-1; the repo is linked (`supabase link`). All three flavors currently point at this one project (a separate production project is in the backlog).
- Migrations (in order): `create_profiles`, `create_seller_tunnel`, `lock_submitted_dossiers`, `lock_document_files`, `rooms_annex_area`, `heating_systems`, `market_estimation` (EPIC-05), `valuations_and_notifications`, `valuation_report_path_check` (EPIC-07), `agent_conversations` (EPIC-06), `multi_biens`, `estimate_outbuildings`, `multi_biens_hardening` (EPIC-13), `voix_etendue`, `agent_step_stats_select_only` (EPIC-14), `room_photos` (EPIC-15), `voix_prioritaire`, `fill_sheet_sources` (EPIC-16: `step_notes`, `field_sources`, `pending_answers`, `dossier_field_catalog`, `staff_voice_thread`, `staff_fill_sheet`), `photos_hardening` (`reorder_room_photos`, `room_photos_keep_main_photo`, `vision_reserve_target`, `vision_save_*`, `staff_orphan_files`), `reorder_full_list`, `coffre_fort_compte` (EPIC-11), `mise_en_vente` (EPIC-08: `sales`, `mandates`, `mandate_signatures`, `sale_requests`, `listing_photos`, buckets `listing-media` / `mandate-signatures` / `sale-documents`, `has_active_sale(owner)`, `staff_*`; `notifications.kind` is a format check, same statement in every epic). Apply new ones with `supabase db push --dry-run` then `supabase db push` (the CLI authenticates with the access token — no DB password needed). Probe RLS with a rolled-back `DO` block via `supabase db query --linked`.
- Server secrets: `supabase secrets set NAME=…` (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`; voice agent models `OPENROUTER_MODEL_STT` / `_AGENT` / `_TTS` and `OPENROUTER_TTS_VOICE`, optional per-step `OPENROUTER_MODEL_AGENT_<STEP>` (e.g. `_ROOMS`), defaults in `supabase/functions/_shared/agent/config.ts`; vision AI `OPENROUTER_MODEL_VISION` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL_PLAN`, defaults in `_shared/vision/config.ts`).
- `render-mandate` (EPIC-08): `{mandate_id}` with the caller's JWT → PDF « SPÉCIMEN » (`pdf-lib`, versioned text `_shared/mandate/template.ts`, same version as SQL `sale_terms_version()` and `SaleRepository.termsVersion`), stored with the service role in `sale-documents`, idempotent.
- Vision functions (EPIC-15): `vision-room` (`{photo_id}` → suggestions for one room photo, stored once in `room_photos.analysis`) and `plan-reader` (`{document_id}` → rooms and areas printed on a `plan` image, stored in `property_documents.extracted.plan_reading`); shared code `_shared/vision/` (caller JWT for the dossier and its files, service role for the journal/analysis through SQL functions that re-check the draft status at write time; same-target requests deduplicated by `vision_reserve_target`; no figure in a photo analysis; daily quotas). Orphan files of `property-documents`: `staff_orphan_files()` + runbook §5 (manual cleanup only). Staff view: `docs/runbooks/certifier-un-dossier.md` §1 bis.
- Edge Functions (Deno) in `supabase/functions/` (shared code in `_shared/`, tests of every function in `tests/`): from `supabase/functions`, `deno fmt --check --line-width 100 . && deno lint . && deno test --allow-read tests/` (CI `edge_functions.yaml`); deploy with `supabase functions deploy <name> --use-api` (no Docker). Voice benchmark (never deployed by default): `supabase/bench/` (see the headers of `run.ts` and `agent-bench/index.ts`).
- The app reads `SUPABASE_URL` / `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` via `String.fromEnvironment`, from `config/<flavor>.json` passed with `--dart-define-from-file` (already set in `.vscode/launch.json`); `Supabase.initialize` runs in `bootstrap()`. Only the publishable key belongs in the app, never the secret/service_role key.
- `supabase/config.toml` mirrors the remote settings: change it, then `supabase config push` (it shows a diff and prompts per service; check the diff doesn't revert dashboard settings). Schema changes go in `supabase/migrations/` (`supabase migration new <name>`, `supabase db push`). Docker isn't installed, so there's no local stack: work against the remote project.
- Auth: magic link. Allowed redirect URLs are `fr.realesty.mobile{.dev,.stg,}://login-callback`, one per flavor (URL scheme = bundle ID via `CFBundleURLTypes`, and `AUTH_REDIRECT_URL` in `config/<flavor>.json`). The link must be opened on the device that requested it (PKCE). Free tier + default email provider: email templates can't be customized (the French templates in `supabase/templates/` are commented out in config.toml until a custom SMTP is set), and sending is heavily rate-limited to the org's team members.
- Dev test sign-in: in the development flavor only, 01 shows a discreet "Connexion de test (dev)" button (`DevTestLoginButton`, `AuthRepository.signInWithPassword`) when `DEV_TEST_EMAIL` and `DEV_TEST_PASSWORD` are both set. They live in the gitignored `config/development.local.json` (`{"DEV_TEST_EMAIL": "…", "DEV_TEST_PASSWORD": "…"}`, an existing Supabase user with a password), passed with an extra `--dart-define-from-file=config/development.local.json` to `flutter run`/`flutter build` (not in `.vscode/launch.json`: the file may not exist). Never commit these credentials.

## Localization

- ARB files in `lib/l10n/arb/`. **French is the reference language**: `app_fr.arb` is the template (add new keys there first, with their `@key` description) and `fr` is listed first via `preferred-supported-locales` in `l10n.yaml`, so it is the fallback locale. `app_en.arb` and `app_es.arb` are secondary translations. Generated code goes to `lib/l10n/gen/` (excluded from analysis; don't edit by hand).
- Access strings via the `context.l10n` extension from `package:mobileapp/l10n/l10n.dart`. Every `MaterialApp` (app and tests) must use `appLocalizationsDelegates` from that file, because `material_ui` ships its own `GlobalMaterialLocalizations` and the generated delegates alone break the French locale. French typography: ’ apostrophes, U+00A0 before : ! ? % €.
- When adding a locale, also add it to `CFBundleLocalizations` in `ios/Runner/Info.plist`.

## Testing

- Test tree mirrors `lib/`. Use `tester.pumpApp(widget)` / `pumpAppRouter` from `test/helpers/helpers.dart`: theme, localizations and every repository/bloc (mock defaults from `test/helpers/mocks.dart`, overridable). Mocked `AuthRepository` must stub `linkFailures`. For pixel-sensitive tests use `loadRealestyFonts()` and `usePhoneSurface()` (390×844).
- CI enforces **100% line coverage**: every new file needs tests.
- Cubits/blocs are tested with `bloc_test` (`blocTest`); mocks use `mocktail`.

## Lints & CI

- `very_good_analysis` + `bloc_lint/recommended` (`public_member_api_docs` disabled).
- CI (`.github/workflows/main.yaml`) tests the root app and each package in `packages/` (one `dart_package` job per package — add one for a new package). It requires semantic PR titles (conventional commits, e.g. `feat: ...`), runs build/analyze/format/test/bloc-lint, and spell-checks Markdown (`.github/cspell.json`). A license check allows only MIT, BSD-2/3-Clause, and Apache-2.0 dependencies.
